name: Lyft

Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Moderate — one coding round plus a distinct 4-round onsite mixing CS fundamentals with design
rounds: Technical phone screen (~1 hr on Coderpad, one question, moderate depth)
Onsite (4 rounds): system design, CS fundamentals, a laptop programming test, and a behavioral interview
Team matching after the loop, not before
extraTopics: CS fundamentals as its own dedicated round, separate from the coding test — distinct from most peers who fold fundamentals into coding rounds
A "laptop programming test" round format (bring-your-own-environment coding)
